add.title: Visual Acoustics: The Modernism of Julius Shulman
add.summary: Eric Bricker's film on Julius Shulman, the photographer whose images shaped how modern architecture was seen.

sources.quote: a documentary film by Eric Bricker that explores the life and career of the much lauded architectural photographer Julius Shulman
